reading: A poster-style hero: a 4-line tight-set 'SOUND' wordmark top-left, a huge circle with small spaced text running round its rim reading 'LISTEN · LOUDER ·' repeated, a smaller vivid red-orange circle inside it labeled 'FM26', a body copy block to the right, a 2-line 'NOV 14–16' date stamp below that, and a near-black marquee bar along the bottom with scrolling cream 'ON AIR ● 98.6 FM ●' text. A typed note also sets page-wide styling: cream background, Helvetica type, near-black text.
